edition: Leonida Ledger v9 (2026-11-20) — sourcing depth: PowerPyx and GTABase now back every trophy, not just the five unconfirmed ones, so the audit reads S3 55/55 and S4 55/55 and every checklist row carries up to four cited sources; three of the five hidden trophies whose trigger no guide had confirmed (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, The Truth Is Out There) now have confirmed methods from PowerPyx, leaving 2 hidden triggers not yet known (Bad Luck, I Guess; Ten Pin). The Shooting Range count is corrected from two ranges to 12, the nine activity types are named, the story-mission chapters are pinned down, and Positive Mental Attitude's window is stated precisely — the morning after Down to Earth, Chapter 1 only. The Missables tab leads with the potentially missable trophy and shows each flagged trophy's progress counter.

roadmap.title: Chapter 1 — play, and save
roadmap.text: Finish the opening mission and Chapter 1, beat Cal at fishing, finish one arcade game, and do the balcony meditation at Jason's house while it is available. Make a manual save at the start of the chapter: there is no mission replay, so a chapter-start save is your only way back.

roadmap.title: Chapters 2–4 — the story
roadmap.text: Play the story through to the final mission. Character switching opens in Chapter 2, which unlocks the partner trophies and the stranger strands. Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3 — it is time-sensitive. Finish the six side-story finales (Andy, Billy, Kenton, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) whenever they appear; they stay open after the credits.

roadmap.title: Robberies and partner feats
roadmap.text: Once the robbery tools arrive in Chapters 3 and 4 — the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, then the bank-vault job near the end of Chapter 4 — take the robbery trophies and the partner feats that ride along with them, including the 4-star escape that also clears Hot Together.

roadmap.title: Open-world sweep
roadmap.text: After the credits, everything outside the story stays open: collectibles (cards, WAiNK spots, vehicles, areas), races, shooting ranges, stunts, Challenges and the money trophies. Work them in any order and let the progress counters in this tracker do the counting.

roadmap.title: 100% and the platinum
roadmap.text: The 100% checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but work done earlier still counts. It needs more than the trophies do — 300 stunts instead of 250, 70 of 80 Challenges, all 8 bank vaults, 200 of 277 vehicle models — so keep grinding past each trophy pop until A Long Road lands, and Vice Got a Price! follows.

saveRules: There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus at launch: once a story mission is done you cannot select it again.
Keep one manual save at the start of every chapter, plus one untouched save from just before the final mission. The game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave.
Do the balcony meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — it is the one trophy reported as potentially missable, and it disappears when the chapter ends.
Do Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 as soon as it appears; it carries an hourglass icon and is time-sensitive.
Never test cheats on your trophy save: cheats are expected to switch off trophies and saving.

tips.text: No mission replay: treat every chapter as one-way. Save manually at each chapter start and before the final mission, so a missed moment costs minutes, not a new playthrough.
Do the balcony meditation at Jason's house the morning after Down to Earth, while Chapter 1 is still open — the potentially missable trophy hangs on it, and the chapter does not reopen.
When Race Against Yago appears in Chapter 3, run it at once: it is the list's one time-sensitive trophy and will not wait for your endgame sweep.
Keep cheats out of your trophy save: they are expected to block saving and trophy progress for the rest of that session.
Hunt the partner trophies as a pair — the wanted-level escape and the back-to-back shop robberies only count with Lucia and Jason together.
Do not chase true 100%: the checklist A Long Road measures asks for roughly 60% of everything the game tracks, so let it name your targets.
Spend your save slots: 15 manual slots plus an autosave covers a save per chapter, one before any one-chance moment, and a Chapter 1 save you never overwrite.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the reward for everything else: it pops the moment the 54th other trophy lands, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Follow the roadmap in order — story first with a save at every chapter start, then the robbery and partner feats, then the open-world sweep — and finish with the 100% checklist, which is the longest single job at roughly 200 hours for the whole platinum. No online, difficulty or medal trophy stands in the way; it is long, not hard.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
Leave A Long Road (100% Completion) for last — it is the longest grind.
Check the tracker above: when 54 of 55 are ticked, this one is next.

sources.note: platinum time ~200 hours; no online / difficulty / medal trophies

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the second gold, and the longest single job in the game. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but work done earlier still counts. Its bars sit above the individual trophies: all robberies including the 8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations, underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks — plus 100 optional missions, 200 of the 277 vehicle scans, 100 of the 255 animal studies, 15 of the 18 meditations, 70 of the 80 Challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Do the story first, then grind the checklist in the open world; expect the whole platinum to take around 200 hours, most of it here.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Clear every line of the checklist — stunts, Challenges, vaults, vehicles, operations.
The trophy pops at 100%; the platinum follows with it.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife-edge flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack them up, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. Progress > Activities > Stunts shows your count, and the map can show every Stunt Spot. The counter runs from the start of the game, so stunts you pull while playing the story already count. Do not stop at 250: the 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past the pop if you want A Long Road.
steps: Pull stunts as you play — jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights, base jumps.
Watch the counter; the trophy pops at 250.
Keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The nine are fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race, and a stunt. Progress > Activities shows what is left. This is a sampler, not a grind: one taste of each, and it pops as soon as the ninth type is tried — most players will clear it by accident while chasing the other activity trophies.
steps: Try one of each of the 9 types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, arcade game, a race win, a stunt.
Check Progress > Activities for what is left; fill the gaps with a single quick session each.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 shooting ranges. This is a skill trophy, not a grind: each challenge has its own gold threshold, so replay a challenge until the medal turns gold and move on. Bring your best aim and a steady trigger finger; there is no difficulty trophy in the game, so the ranges are the same for everyone. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.
steps: Find a shooting range (there are 12).
Play each challenge and chase the gold medal threshold.
Replay any challenge that lands silver or bronze until all 42 are gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. One win per location is enough — you do not need to win every race a location offers, just one at each of the 14. Fly the drone courses cleanly and learn each course's turns; a win at a location you have already won does not advance the counter, so track which locations are left in this tracker.
steps: Find the Top Fun Drone Race locations across Leonida (14 in total).
Win at least one race at each location.
The trophy pops when the 14th location is won.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the key word: winning the same race twice counts once, so you need 20 distinct race events across the map — street races, and any other race types the game offers. There are 40 races to choose from. The Yago street race strand in Chapter 3 counts toward this too, so do the races as they appear rather than leaving them all for the endgame.
steps: Enter races across Leonida — street races and any other race types.
Win 20 different race events (repeats do not count).
Check the counter after each win; the trophy pops at 20.

Win the challenge and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. Meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, so bring your partner every time. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and it is not confirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game phone app for scanning and tagging places — open it at landmarks, businesses and viewpoints across Leonida and the location counts. Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags; open the app with Up on the D-pad, then R1 or RB. It pairs naturally with the other map-clearing trophies: while you sweep for the 52 areas of The Goodtime State and the 100 vehicles of Whip It Good, WAiNK each spot you pass. One hundred locations is a lot, so fold it into your general map sweep instead of grinding it alone.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges, and many complete on their own while you play — driving, fighting, exploring and collecting all feed them. Do not grind them first: play the rest of the list and check the Challenges screen regularly, then mop up the easiest unfinished ones at the end. The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so keep going past 50 if you want A Long Road.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level and then lose it completely. Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle or Y) — possible once both characters are together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well. The easiest honest route is a bank vault job: vaults give you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, and escaping one with your partner also earns this. Note the timing — it only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area — so keep driving until the stars are fully gone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row without losing your Wanted Level. The trick is the opposite of a normal escape: keep the police chasing you the whole time. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks — so move fast between shops and do not hide. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) are close together; go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.

Rob a shop, then a second and a third, back to back.
Keep the Wanted Level alive the whole time — do not let the stars fade.

The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100.

Set it up rather than hoping for it — pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation. Use an assault rifle so each shot lands fast, and stretch the window until the fifth enemy drops.

If enemies are scarce, try it during a gang operation or a chase rather than on random pedestrians. Keep a manual save before experimenting — a botched attempt usually means a wanted level — and do it in free roam, where a failed try costs nothing and can be repeated straight away.
